name: Level loading, restart and screenshot highlights
description: Covers list_campaigns, go_to_level over the stock and challenge campaigns, out-of-range campaign and level indices, every challenge and Muscle Temple campaign once, a fractional campaign index sent to the mod's message handler directly, a load from the main menu with no save slot it could use, a load from the pause menu and a restart from a cutscene (a persistent object the pause deactivated is active again after each), the slot tools refused on a finished level, during the switch to the next scene and during a fade, a level index past the campaign's end (the Victory map), an intro cutscene re-armed for Indiana Brones on Mission1's first level, whose bros arrive by transport, which go_to_level and restart_level each answer once it holds the level, naming it, and start skips, and a load while a MonoBehaviour's Update holds the main thread past its 3 s budget, which leaves the level as it was; restart_level in a level and at the main menu, where it is refused; inspect_player in a level; and take_screenshot plain and with every highlight form: an object path, an off-screen object, an object with nothing to outline, an inactive or missing object, an empty path, rectangles on, partly on and off the screen or with a negative size, a rectangle missing a field, null, and a number, array and bool sent to the mod's message handler directly from a thread of its own, since the server refuses them before they are sent. The highlights use campaign 0 level 2: the on-screen rectangles are computed from the camera's view, whatever the window size, and sent to the mod's message handler from a thread of their own; the off-screen ones sit a million units away; and probe objects the script creates above the bro. Needs Utility Mod's disableEnemySpawn on for the load warning. It changes no Utility Mod setting itself: its restore only puts back what a failed spawning.json run recorded, so a settings save during the run writes the user's values. Its first steps undo whatever an earlier run left changed and wait for any load in progress to settle; its last steps destroy the probes and reload the level it started in. Its cleanup runs the restore again whatever ended the steps: pause, speed, the second player, IronBro, the lock, the Swap Bros selection, Indiana Brones's unlock and the bros yet to be played, and the Utility Mod settings and HeroController values that a failed spawning or inspection run recorded.
